import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).reset_index()
product_sales.columns = ['product', 'total_sales']

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(data=product_sales, x='total_sales', y='product', orient='h')
plt.xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.ylabel('Product')
plt.title('Total Sales by Product (Top 10)')
plt.xlim(0, product_sales['total_sales'].max() * 1.1)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
